Command: Do not gather grapes of the untrimmed vine in the sabbatical year
Summary: In the sabbatical year, the grapes of the untrimmed vine are not to be gathered as a harvest.
Commandment: Do not gather grapes of the untrimmed vine in the sabbatical year.
Application: As in Jubilee, the sabbatical vine is left untrimmed and its fruit unharvested: the year's growth is free for the poor and the beasts, not gathered as a crop. The mirror between sabbatical and Jubilee rules guards both years' character as release.
Purpose: To prevent permanent destitution and permanent debt in Israel (Leviticus 25; Deuteronomy 15). In the sabbatical year, that purpose takes the form of leaving the untrimmed vine ungathered.
